newsitem.title: INDIA: CARE upbeat on India SPIC performance.
newsitem.headline: CARE upbeat on India SPIC performance.

text.p: India's Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation Ltd's (SPIC) liquidity position is comfortable and its gearing and interest coverage are expected to improve during the year, rating firm Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Wednesday.
CARE said this in a report wherein it assigned an AA+ rating for SPIC's 1.0 billion rupee non-convertible debenture issue.
It also assigned PR1+ rating for SPIC's commercial paper programme for a limit upto 1.0 billion rupees.
SPIC is one of India's leading fertiliser producers.

"With no fresh borrowing programmes envisaged (other than those rated now, which will replace existing borrowings), gearing and interest coverage are expected to improve. Liquidity position remains comfortable," CARE said in a statement.
CARE said SPIC's return on capital employed is expected to improve from the 1997/98 financial year as new projects go on stream.

"With the demand-supply gap for fertilisers expected to continue, SPIC is not expected to face any problems on this front. Moreover, the company's strategic investment in an offshore phosphoric acid plant is likely to improve its competitive edge," CARE said.
